page_title: SAS 0-1 ROM | Sassuolo v AS Roma 26/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Gianluca Manganiello has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+6' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Arijanet Muric, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
90+4' A quickly taken corner by AS Roma.
90+3' AS Roma take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+3' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Arijanet Muric was alert and the score remains the same. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AS Roma.
90+2' Sassuolo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+1' Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and Sassuolo manage to earn a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Fabio Grosso appears to have said too much and referee Gianluca Manganiello comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
90' Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
87' The substitution has been made. Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) has replaced Wesley Franca.
87' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AS Roma.
83' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.
82' Sassuolo fail to score from a corner as Mile Svilar (AS Roma) leaps to collect the ball.
81' Fabio Grosso prepares a substitution. Ismael Kone is replaced by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo).
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo) comes onto the pitch so that Alieu Fadera can be given a rest.
80' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) meets a cross inside the box and heads it goalwards. Unfortunately for him, he sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar. What a chance!
79' AS Roma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
77' The foul by Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Gianluca Manganiello.
77' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
77' The corner is swung in but AS Roma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

76' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Arijanet Muric guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The referee blows his whistle, AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
74' Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
71' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) commits a rough challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.

69' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Gianluca Manganiello with no other option than to blow for a foul.
68' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the right post and flies out of play.
66' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Paulo Dybala will be replaced by Matias Soule (AS Roma).
66' The referee allows time for a substitution. Bryan Cristante will be replaced by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma).
64' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes well wide of the right post.
62' Gianluca Manganiello interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo).
60' Fabio Grosso has decided to substitute Kristian Thorstvedt and he is replaced by Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo).
60' The medical team appears concerned about a possible head injury to Domenico Berardi. He’ll take no further part in the game and Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) replaces him.
58' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) picks up an injury.
57' A neat pass is well received by Zeki Celik (AS Roma), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
54' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
53' Sassuolo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
52' Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
50' Here is a change. Leon Bailey is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma).
48' Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
47' Gianluca Manganiello shows a yellow card to Mario Hermoso (AS Roma), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
46' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
46' Gian Piero Gasperini makes a switch. Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) is coming on in place of Konstantinos Tsimikas at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Rough tackle by Bryan Cristante (AS Roma). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Gianluca Manganiello no option but to blow his whistle.
43' Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul after Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
40' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance!
39' Filippo Romagna is substituted due to injury. Fabio Grosso gives a chance to Fali Cande (Sassuolo).
37' Filippo Romagna (Sassuolo) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
37' Gianluca Manganiello shows the yellow card to Josh Doig (Sassuolo) for a heavy challenge.
36' Gianluca Manganiello couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) and blew his whistle.
34' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) is cautioned by the referee.
33' Great touch by Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
32' Arijanet Muric makes a save to deny the long-range effort from Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) towards the middle of the goal.
30' A spell of possession for AS Roma in an attempt to control the game.
29' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Leon Bailey (AS Roma) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Gianluca Manganiello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
27' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo), whose header flies narrowly wide of the left post.
27' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
26' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) collects an inch-perfect pass and strikes the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked. Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick.
26' Sassuolo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
24' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) has received a yellow card for his foul.
22' Ball possession – 40:60.
20' Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) commits a rough foul. Gianluca Manganiello stops the game and makes a call.

16' 0 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot inside the right post. His attempt was beyond the reach of Arijanet Muric, so the score changes to 0:1.

16' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Arijanet Muric has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
15' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
15' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
15' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. It will be a corner kick for AS Roma.
14' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) trips an opposition player and Gianluca Manganiello signals a foul.
12' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) latches on to a precise cross on the edge of the box and strikes the ball goalwards. However, it goes just over the crossbar.
12' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
9' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Filippo Romagna (Sassuolo) latches onto a rebound and hits a long-range effort that flies well over the bar.
7' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sassuolo comes to nothing.

7' That was a nice football moment. Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the left post. Mile Svilar guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! Good work from Sassuolo as they win a corner.
5' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box finds Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo), whose header flies way wide of the left post.
3' Flag up against Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
3' Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) is penalised for holding. Gianluca Manganiello signals a set piece.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Sassuolo will kick-off.
Gianluca Manganiello got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
